A few good questions.

Is $4.99 a monthly subscription?

No. The pack is a one-time purchase of 10 conversions for US$4.99.

Can I try the tool for free?

Yes. Free test conversions include a visible watermark. Use a test result to review the tracing before choosing a paid option.

Which payment methods will be available?

Card checkout through Stripe and PayPal are being prepared. Paid checkout will open once purchases can reliably unlock your conversion credits.

Will the SVG open in my design software?

SVG is supported by many vector editors. Open our sample in your own software to check compatibility before purchasing.

Download a sample SVG ↓
What happens if I need more conversions?

You’ll be able to buy another 10-conversion pack when paid checkout is available.
